Ruling: model reading error; project retained; model value dropped from the fixture. The filer answered No to paying for care (f2441.care) and each of the six dependents was given as not a qualifying person for Form 2441, yet the model added three dependents' column (d) amounts ($1,480, $1,850 and $1,240), treating them as qualifying under the filer's answer about a qualifying person who is not a dependent. Line 2 lists only qualifying persons (i2441 p. 3, Line 2, "Don't list a person on line 2 unless they are listed as an eligible person under Qualifying Person(s), earlier"), so column (d) is empty and line 3 is zero; that answer refuses the form (f2441.nondependent_gate) only when care was paid, which the filer denied. The model's own line 16 is zero, against its line 3, and line 6 and the credit are zero either way (line 4 is zero). No change to the data.

Ruling: model error; f2441 (2025) p. 2, line 30: "Complete line 2 on page 1 of this form. Don’t include in column (d) any benefits shown on line 28 above. Then, add the amounts in column (d) and enter the total here"; i2441 p. 3, Column (d): "If you completed Part III, don't include in column (d) any benefits shown on line 28." The prompt (.classm/classm.f2441.5.prompt.txt) gives the two persons' "Qualified expenses you incurred and paid in 2025" as $2,500.00 and $3,500.00 and the case works line 28 at $2,000.00 (line 25 excluded benefits, agreed). The model's work, "Column (d) total: 2,500 + 3,500", adds the expenses without leaving out the line 28 benefits, giving $6,000.00. Under either reading recorded in amb.2025.dc_line30 (the total less line 28, the chosen reading; or each person's column (d) net of the benefits for that person) the total is $6,000.00 less $2,000.00 = $4,000.00, the project's value, since no allocation of $2,000 between $2,500 and $3,500 leaves a negative amount; the ambiguity is the allocation, not the total. Line 31 (the smaller of lines 29 and 30) agrees at $4,000.00 on both sides. This reclassifies the earlier "ambiguity" ruling of the same disagreement: the model's number contradicts both readings. The fixture's $6,000.00 for f2441.line30 is this open disagreement's model value and causes the classm.f2441.5 failure in test-fixtures (expected $6,000.00, got $4,000.00); dropping it clears it.
